Michael Dillon is a historian of China whose work focuses on modern Chinese history, politics and society. In his new book, Shanghai: The Story of China’s Most Dynamic City, he traces the city’s development from a small fishing village into China’s wealthiest metropolis and one of its most important financial centres.
